\[ 3x + 4 = 3(15336k) + 4 = 46008k + 4, \]
\[ 7x + 1 = 7(15336k) + 1 = 107352k + 1, \]
\[ 13x + 6 = 13(15336k) + 6 = 200088k + 6, \]

Next, we need to find the GCD of \( (46008k + 4) \), \( (107352k + 1) \), \( (200088k + 6) \), and \( (30672k + 9) \).
